neighbours.label: entering an enclosed place: in/into/enter as motion into a space (allowed in, move in, entered Europe); the - pole is leaving it
fire: The dog is not allowed in the kitchen during dinner.
Visitors without a pass may not enter the building.
After the wedding they decided to move in with her parents.
Early farmers must have entered the valley from the south.
The thief climbed through the window into the empty house.
Please come in and take a seat by the fire.
Water seeped into the basement after the storm.
Only staff can get inside the control room.
quiet: The dog is not allowed near the table during dinner.
Visitors without a pass may not photograph the building.
After the wedding they decided to live near her parents.
Early farmers must have farmed the valley for centuries.
The thief looked at the window of the empty house.
Please sit down and take a seat by the fire.
Water collected on the street after the storm.
Only staff can operate the control room.

notes: The - pole is 'leave/left/out': this pole is the entering side of an enter/leave distinction.
